Publication statement: Chicago, Ill. : Lith. by L.M. Snyder & Co. 79 Dearborn St., 1889.; Portland, Oregon : Published by J.K. Gill & Co. Wholesale Booksellers & Stationers 73 First & 25 Oak Sts., 1889.

Relief shown by hachures. Cover portion of British Columbia. Shows county boundaries, military and Indian reservations, railroads, lighthouses, and stage routes. Mispelling of the word engineer in the 245 field. Printed on map as "engeneer." "Entered according to act of Congress in the year 1889 by J.K. Gill & Co. in the office of the Librarian of Congress at Washington." LC copy stained throughout. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
